name: hand-computed
description: Expectations written by hand from p2/contracts/receipt-v1.md against the golden fixture. No value here was produced by the scorer.

warnings.message: recipe 101 does not state a quantity for ingredient 14
inventory row for ingredient 13 expired on 2026-10-09
inventory row for ingredient 15 stores no unit

hand_notes: Recipe 101, ingredient 11: usable is 200 g (fridge, expires 2026-10-12) + 150 g (freezer, expires exactly on as_of_date, therefore still usable) = 350 g against 500 g required. Short, so status is missing.

Recipe 101, ingredient 13: the only row expired on 2026-10-09, one day before as_of_date, so available_qty is 0 and status is expired. The requirement is 0, so nothing is missing either — status describes the inventory row, not whether the requirement was met. This line was first written as ok and the harness rejected it; the contract was clarified rather than the harness loosened. A scorer reading (relative_unit_100 || 100) would require 100 g here and report missing.
Recipe 101, ingredient 14: quantity is null, so unknown_requirement rather than a default or a zero.
Recipe 102 asks 2 servings, so 100 g becomes 200 g and 1 L becomes 2 L. 350 g usable covers 200 g. Ingredient 15 stores no unit, so under decision D2 it is unresolved rather than compared.
Recipe 103 requires nothing: a defined zero score and an empty item list, not a crash or a null.
Ordering: 3.0 > 1.0 > 0.0, so 101, 102, 103. No tie in this case; the tie rule is exercised by the shuffle check.
